title: Google Ads Transparency Center input
description: List the ads an advertiser or a website runs on Google (Search, YouTube, Display), from the public Google Ads Transparency Center. Search by domain, advertiser name or advertiser ID.

searchTerms.title: Domains, advertiser names or IDs
searchTerms.description: One per line. A website domain ("nike.com": every advertiser that sends traffic to it), an advertiser name ("Nike, Inc.": the advertiser with this exact name and the most ads is picked; the log lists similar names), an advertiser ID ("AR16735076323512287233") or a Transparency Center advertiser link. Domains and IDs are the most precise.

region.title: Region (country where the ad was shown)
region.description: 2-letter country code such as US, GB, DE, FR, IN, or "anywhere" for all countries.

period.title: Period (when the ad was shown)
period.description: Only ads shown in this period. Google keeps the day-by-day data for about the last 12 months; for older periods it returns no ads.

startDate.title: Start date (custom period)
startDate.description: First day, as YYYY-MM-DD. Used only when Period is "Custom dates".

endDate.title: End date (custom period)
endDate.description: Last day, as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty = today. Used only when Period is "Custom dates".

format.title: Ad format
format.description: Text ads (Google Search), image ads (Display, Shopping) or video ads (YouTube).

maxAdsPerQuery.title: Max ads per domain / advertiser
maxAdsPerQuery.description: Stop after this many ads for each line above. Big brands have thousands of ads; you pay per ad stored.

includeDetails.title: Add countries and all variants
includeDetails.description: For each ad, also read its detail page: every country where it was shown and all its versions (images or previews). One extra request per ad, so runs take about twice as long. Same price.

requestDelaySecs.title: Pause between requests (seconds)
requestDelaySecs.description: The Actor sends one request at a time and waits this long between them, to stay within Google's limits. Minimum 1.

maxBlockWaitSecs.title: Max wait when Google asks to slow down (seconds)
maxBlockWaitSecs.description: If Google answers with its rate-limit page, the Actor waits (30 s, then 60 s, 120 s...) and retries on the same IP. It never solves captchas and never switches IP to get around a block. After this much waiting the run stops and keeps the ads already read.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Default: the Apify proxy (datacenter), one IP for the whole run. The Apify RESIDENTIAL and GOOGLE_SERP groups are not available in this Actor; for other IPs add your own proxy URLs.
